description: Source code implementing adaptive pooling operations optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including functions for adaptive average and max pooling, their backward passes, and utility functions for kernel parameter calculation.

methods.name: set_kernel_params
methods.description: Calculates stride and kernel size parameters for adaptive pooling based on input and output sizes.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_out_mps
methods.description: Performs adaptive average pooling for MPS backend, handling different input dimensions and computing output.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_mps
methods.description: Creates output tensor and calls the out variant for adaptive average pooling on MPS.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_backward_mps
methods.description: Computes the backward pass for adaptive average pooling on MPS.

methods.name: adaptive_max_pool2d_out_mps
methods.description: Performs adaptive max pooling with indices for MPS backend.

methods.name: adaptive_max_pool2d_backward_out_mps
methods.description: Computes the backward pass for adaptive max pooling with indices on MPS.
